name: Subnet Sherpa
description: A friendly IPv4 subnet calculator in your toolbar. Paste an address with a prefix or a dotted mask and see the network address, broadcast address, first and last usable host, host count, inverse mask and address type. Carve a network into equal subnets, convert an address range into CIDR blocks, and test membership. Offline, no permissions, no tracking.

browser_action.default_title: Subnet Sherpa — Your guide through IPv4 masks
